beam.basis: Simply supported Euler-Bernoulli beam; minimum net orthogonal casting section over foot span, steel ignored; X-group weight lumped at its measured CAD mass centre; full mechanism X25..retract evaluated by exact prismatic COM translation, reference moving mass; old 210 mm bed uses its original 860 mm support span over the new X range; previous heavy-plinth/full-stroke result is retained separately; 121 mm guide Abbe height; current work-to-table-seat lever follows TABLE_SEAT; old table lever233 mm; bound combines radial and vertical peak-to-peak changes. Assumed E sensitivity 0.5x..2x. Excludes floor/foot compliance, torsion, joints, local contact and modes; external FEA remains open.

millReference: machinekit.milling.MillFrame foot-access and foot-stem casting cores; mill retains its own cast-in seats.
